integrity: The infinite proof uses a cited published structural lemma and explicit coefficient identities. An independent finite verifier corroborates but does not certify the theorem for all lengths; no external independent audit has been carried out.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to maximal codes under coordinatewise order for the consecutive 321 pattern and lengths at least two; no claim about all pattern avoiders, real-rootedness or adjacent nonconsecutive patterns. The underlying block characterization and defect expression are published prior work; novelty assessment concerns the all-length unimodality threshold.
title: Sharp nonunimodality threshold for maximal consecutive-321 Lehmer codes
